A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SoftKI research. All 25 pages of v2 and 20 pages of v3, including figures, tables, equations and appendices A–C, support comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original UCI and MD22 regression results, Ricker wavelet experiments, and solver and interpolation-point analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains original regression experiments and reports additional Exact GP and SGPR-QR results and revised numerical-stability results.

M1.justification: SoftKI's interpolation, stabilized objective and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. v3 additionally adapts the QR inference procedure to SGPR, producing the SGPR-QR variant described in Section 3.3 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 12 UCI datasets, seven MD22 molecular-energy datasets and Ricker wavelet task. Double-walled-nanotube is shortened to DW-nanotube; the added comparisons do not introduce new data or task coverage.

E2.justification: v3 adds evaluated Exact GP references to the main UCI and MD22 comparisons and introduces SGPR-QR in Table 7. Exact GP previously appeared only through attributed results in the separate SKI comparison. SGPR, SVGP, SKI, SKIP and Simplex-SKI remain in their corresponding retained comparisons.

E3.justification: The stability comparison changes its stated control from stabilized MLL in v2 Table 5 to pure SoftKI MLL in v3 Table 6. New Exact GP experiments use block CG and 50 training epochs, including MD22 where approximate methods retain 200 epochs. Existing benchmark splits, minibatch sizes and interpolation-point counts remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v3 removes the high-dimensional PCA/KDE and UMAP analyses, interpolation-point-count sensitivity, and Ricker probe-count comparison. It revises the MLL stability experiment and adds the SGPR QR-solver control. The original SoftKI solver comparison, Ricker error surfaces, and lengthscale/temperature analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report benchmark averages across three seeds and use mean-plus/minus reporting. No changed repeat-count policy, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedure is documented.

E6.justification: v3 adds Exact GP scores, SGPR-QR results and MD22 timings, and revises existing SGPR values: Keggdirected RMSE changes from 0.251±0.130 to 0.099±0.004. Main SoftKI and SVGP scores remain unchanged apart from formatting. The revised pure-MLL comparison reports four failures under its changed control. The new claimed 20–875× Exact GP slowdown is not fully supported by Table 10: At-at gives approximately 7.3×.

T1.justification: The MLL and pseudoloss derivative expressions change trace-term signs between v2 Equations 14/16 and v3 Equations 6/8. v3 also corrects covariance-matrix dimensions, adds the general ELBO and variational-family formulation, and revises the Sparse-Grid complexity expression. Appendix A's substantive proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and central scalability and competitiveness claims are retained. The introduction and conclusion drop the claim that high-dimensional learned interpolation points are structurally different from SGPR/SVGP inducing points; the introduction instead highlights numerical-stability analysis.

C2.justification: v3 removes explanations linking wider interpolation-point distributions to prior/objective differences and interpreting deterioration with more points as overfitting. It replaces the earlier largely similar-objective interpretation with an explicit pure-MLL accuracy/stability tradeoff, clarifies the pseudoloss's gradient-approximation role, and distinguishes QR's effects on SGPR accuracy from its importance for SoftKI stability.

D1.justification: v3 adds an implementation repository link and documents the Exact GP implementation using block CG with KeOps/GPyTorch. It makes ARD explicit in the benchmark description and adds MD22 timing information. Hardware and existing Ricker settings remain unchanged; ARD was already evidenced by v2's per-dimension lengthscale analysis.

R1.justification: v3 adds Cunningham, Cutajar, Bungartz–Griebel and Charlier references, expands discussion of CG-based exact inference, and distinguishes SKI from KISS-GP. The UMAP reference is removed with its analysis. Updates to the GPyTorch, VNNGP and Sparse-Grid bibliographic entries refer to retained works.

P1.justification: v3 merges Background and Related Work, reorganizes the SGPR exposition, renames method subsections, and moves the revised stability discussion into the main experiments while removing the learned-points section. Appendices B and C are reorganized, explanations and captions expand, and publication and author information changes.

P2.justification: v3 adds a complexity table, SGPR-QR table and MD22 timing table, expands benchmark tables with Exact GP columns, and captions the previously unnumbered Ricker settings table. Five figures are removed. Retained plot images are identical, but are relocated or renumbered; the lengthscale and temperature figures are consolidated onto one page with expanded captions.

improvement.justification: v3 provides better context for the central approximation claims through Exact GP accuracy/timing references, an SGPR-QR control, explicit pure-MLL failures and an implementation link. These improve evaluation transparency. The gains are partly offset by removing point-count and probe sensitivity evidence and geometry analyses, while the overstated lower bound of the Exact GP timing range introduces a reporting inconsistency. The net improvement is therefore limited.
